answer: Real operators work in bursts and then pause: a cluster of rapid actions followed by a thinking gap, then another cluster. The burst-pause rhythm — cluster size, intra-burst gap, inter-burst pause — is hard to fake consistently, so sessions are scored on how well their burst structure matches the account's established rhythm, and a flat metronomic stream is treated as automation. The design treats each session as a pearl: small alone, decisive in aggregate. When the nadir settles over the gale, the session holds because every action carried its own proof.
